scope: Future separately reviewed candidate-lock waves under RCLE_UNSEEN_EXTERNAL_CONFIRMATION_SOURCE_DISCOVERY_R3. The active VECtor/MVSEC successor lock and all prior outcomes remain immutable.

problem.old_rule: Every exact capture had to expose a complete synchronized depth/pose time grid within a 16 MiB pre-payload probe.
problem.failure_mode: For a non-seekable compressed member, exact depth timestamps may be physically unreachable without transferring the member from its beginning. Treating that transport property as scientific ineligibility creates a false source negative.
problem.example: DLR RealSense ROS bags are individually DEFLATE-compressed members inside a publisher ZIP, while the matching Vicon bags are small independently addressable members. The Vicon time grid can be checked cheaply, but the exact RealSense depth grid cannot always be reached within 16 MiB.

class_a_exact_timegrid.definition: Exact depth and pose timestamp grids are addressable within the bounded probe.
requirements: Run the complete R1 pre-payload time-grid checks.
Reject only the exact capture when the checks fail.

class_b_transport_deferred_depth_timegri.definition: Exact depth timestamps are not addressable within the bounded probe solely because of non-seekable container compression or equivalent transport layout.
prelock_requirements: Freeze the publisher-controlled outer object identity and exact depth member name, compressed bytes, uncompressed bytes, CRC32, compression method, and local-header offset.
Freeze the matching pose member identity and verify its source timestamps, duration, strict monotonicity, frame identities, and capture binding without decoding pose coordinates.
Bind official source-format evidence for the depth topic, source-native timestamp field, metric depth encoding, intrinsics, and nominal cadence.
Prove that the exact depth member plus all required pose/calibration members fit the remaining global transport budget.
Place the capture in a deterministic queue before any new geometry outcome is read.
Record why an exact bounded depth-timegrid probe is physically infeasible.
immediate_post_download_gate: Before geometry formula execution, read only depth timestamp/topic/encoding/intrinsic metadata and verify nonzero finite strictly increasing timestamps.

Assess each unchanged fixed 10-second half-open window independently. Within that window, all source-consecutive depth pairs form the predeclared fixed denominator before any dt or evaluability check; require at least 90 such pairs, and the window fails the time-grid gate if any source-consecutive pair has dt greater than 0.100 seconds. No pair may be filtered by dt or evaluability before this check, and every later failed or unevaluable pair remains in that window's fixed denominator.

A failed fixed window is excluded without moving its anchor, sliding, padding, merging, or invalidating other fixed windows in the same capture. The capture passes the time-grid gate when at least one unchanged fixed window passes; if zero fixed windows pass, mark only that capture TIMEGRID_NOT_EVALUABLE, retain the receipt, delete re-downloadable payload when authorized, and continue to the next prelocked capture.
Do not decode depth values or execute the geometry formula when the post-download time-grid gate fails.

unchanged_scientific_gates.window_grid: Per capture, non-overlapping half-open windows anchored at the earliest synchronized source timestamp; incomplete trailing windows are excluded; no sliding.
unchanged_scientific_gates.abstention_policy: No imputation. A failed or unevaluable pair remains in the fixed denominator.

compatibility.only_replaced_r1_requirement: For class B captures only, exact depth timestamps need not be addressable inside the 16 MiB pre-payload probe; they are instead checked by the mandatory immediate post-download gate before depth-value decode or geometry execution.
all_other_r1_requirements_continue: deterministic candidate lock before new geometry outcomes
post-outcome extension within the current lock remains forbidden
all actual probe, partial, retry, resume, failed-transfer, duplicate, and payload network bytes remain in the global ledger

minimal_failure_propagation.transport_layout_failure: Does not reject a capture or family when class B requirements can be met.
minimal_failure_propagation.whole_family_rejection: Requires family-wide official format evidence or exhaustion of a predeclared family registry.
